pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal regions with predominantly soft-edge pixel gradients. Spatial area of patches is heterogenous, with larger, more elongated shapes on the upper neck transitioning to smaller, more equilateral geometries on the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways. Junction nodes are primarily trivalent. Pixel thickness of the corridors is relatively uniform across the mid-flank, exhibiting high topological continuity.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible as a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged line along the superior neck contour, though pixel definition is softened by atmospheric or focus blur.
